description: Abbreviation for nicotinamide-adenine dinucleotide when its oxidation state is unknown or unspecified. It is used in metabolic pathways like glycolysis and citric acid cycle.
terms.label: NAD

description: A coenzyme that may be NAD<small><sup>+</small></sup> or NADP<small><sup>+</small></sup>.
terms.label: NAD(P)(+)

description: Any constitutionally or isotopically distinct atom, molecule, ion, ion pair, radical, radical ion, complex, conformer etc., identifiable as a separately distinguishable entity.
terms.label: molecular entity

description: A chemical entity is a physical entity of interest in chemistry including molecular entities, parts thereof, and chemical substances.
terms.label: chemical entity

description: A cyclic compound having as ring members atoms of carbon and at least of one other element.
terms.label: organic heterocyclic compound

description: Any polyatomic entity that is an electrically neutral entity consisting of more than one atom.
terms.label: molecule

description: A coenzyme that may be NAD or NADP.
terms.label: NAD(P)

description: A nucleobase-containing molecular entity that is a nucleoside in which one or more of the sugar hydroxy groups has been converted into a mono- or poly-phosphate. The term includes both nucleotides and non-nucleotide nucleoside phosphates.
terms.label: nucleoside phosphate

description: An organophosphorus compound is formally a compound containing at least one carbon-phosphorus bond, but the term is often extended to include esters and thioesters.
terms.label: organophosphorus compound

description: Salts and esters of phosphoric and oligophosphoric acids and their chalcogen analogues. In inorganic chemistry, the term is also used to describe anionic coordination entities with phosphorus as central atom.
terms.label: phosphate

description: Any nucleotide that has a purine nucleobase.
terms.label: purine nucleotide

description: A class of imidazopyrimidines that consists of purine and its substituted derivatives.
terms.label: purines

description: Any organonitrogen heterocyclic compound based on a pyridine skeleton and its substituted derivatives.
terms.label: pyridines

description: A heteroorganic entity is an organic molecular entity in which carbon atoms or organic groups are bonded directly to one or more heteroatoms.
terms.label: heteroorganic entity

description: A p-block molecular entity containing any pnictogen.
terms.label: pnictogen molecular entity

description: Any p-block molecular entity containing a chalcogen.
terms.label: chalcogen molecular entity

description: A molecular entity containing one or more atoms from any of groups 1, 2, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, and 18 of the periodic table.
terms.label: main group molecular entity

description: Any molecule that consists of a series of atoms joined together to form a ring.
terms.label: cyclic compound

description: A molecule that features two fused rings.
terms.label: bicyclic compound

description: A cyclically conjugated molecular entity with a stability (due to delocalization) significantly greater than that of a hypothetical localized structure (e.g. Kekulé structure) is said to possess aromatic character.
terms.label: aromatic compound

description: A polycyclic compound in which at least one of the rings contains at least one non-carbon atom.
terms.label: heteropolycyclic compound

description: A bicyclic compound in which at least one of the rings contains at least one skeletal heteroatom.
terms.label: heterobicyclic compound

description: A main group molecular entity that contains one or more atoms of a p-block element.
terms.label: p-block molecular entity

description: Any organic molecule that consists of atoms connected in the form of a ring.
terms.label: organic cyclic compound

description: A heterocyclic compound formally derived from an arene by replacement of one or more methine (‒C=) and/or vinylene (‒CH=CH‒) groups by trivalent or divalent heteroatoms, respectively, in such a way as to maintain the continuous π-electron system characteristic of aromatic systems and a number of out-of-plane π-electrons corresponding to the Hückel rule (4n+2).
terms.label: heteroarene

description: Any heteroorganic entity containing at least one carbon-nitrogen bond.
terms.label: organonitrogen compound

description: A compound formally derived from an oxoacid RkE(=O)l(OH)m (l > 0) and an alcohol, phenol, heteroarenol, or enol by linking with formal loss of water from an acidic hydroxy group of the former and a hydroxy group of the latter.
terms.label: ester

description: Any molecular entity consisting of more than one atom.
terms.label: polyatomic entity

description: An organochalcogen compound is a compound containing at least one carbon-chalcogen bond.
terms.label: organochalcogen compound

description: An organochalcogen compound containing at least one carbon-oxygen bond.
terms.label: organooxygen compound

description: A nucleotide is a nucleoside phosphate resulting from the condensation of the 3 or 5 hydroxy group of a nucleoside with phosphoric acid.
terms.label: nucleotide

description: A molecular entity consisting of two or more chemical elements.
terms.label: heteroatomic molecular entity

description: Any organonitrogen compound containing a cyclic component with nitrogen and at least one other element as ring member atoms.
terms.label: organonitrogen heterocyclic compound

description: Any molecular entity that contains carbon.
terms.label: organic molecular entity

description: A cyclic compound having as ring members atoms of at least two different elements.
terms.label: heterocyclic compound

description: Any compound that has a nucleobase as a part.
terms.label: nucleobase-containing molecular entity

description: A  nucleotide having adenine as the base.
terms.label: adenyl nucleotide

description: Any molecule that consists of at least one carbon atom as part of the electrically neutral entity.
terms.label: organic molecule
